recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up core source work is needed for FHIR-25202 unless BRR later chooses to revise or remove these search parameters through a new tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-25202 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked BRR to add dose-form search parameters to AdministrableProductDefinition and ManufacturedItemDefinition.
initial_application: No commit message explicitly references FHIR-25202, but the requested search parameters were present when the current R5 medication definition resource sources were added: commit 9765a2c28472 added AdministrableProductDefinition-dose-form over AdministrableProductDefinition.administrableDoseForm, and commit 394c903af807 added ManufacturedItemDefinition-dose-form over ManufacturedItemDefinition.manufacturedDoseForm. Later source refactors updated the same SearchParameter resources from xpathUsage to processingMode and standards status without removing the dose-form parameters.
additional_context: Both resources are active in the current build through source/fhir.ini, and their bundle-*-search-params.xml files now contain normative token SearchParameter definitions with code dose-form and expressions pointing at the current dose-form elements. FHIR-25196 split the search-parameter request out from a withdrawn/no-change element rename request, so the current longer element names are not a conflict. Jira search found no later final issue reversing these search parameters, and direct Zulip/Confluence searches for FHIR-25202 found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already implements the requested dose-form search parameters in the active AdministrableProductDefinition and ManufacturedItemDefinition resource folders.
